title: A Birthday Surprise
description: Practise past tenses, then write a short story about a birthday surprise.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 🎂 On Mai's birthday, her friends ___ a big surprise.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Mai was reading in her room while we ___ decorating the house.
exercises.explanation: Use were with we in the past continuous.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Ben hid the present in the wardrobe.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: We wanted to buy a cake, ___ the shop was closed.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Dad buyed a big balloon for Mai.
answers: Dad bought a big balloon for Mai.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
answers: Mai didn't know about the party.
exercises.explanation: Use didn't + base verb to say something was not true.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: When Mai walked in, we ___ the birthday song.
exercises.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Lucy is the friend ___ made the cake.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Tom gave her a new book.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Mai blew out the candles ___ she made a wish.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Nobody didn't tell Mai about the party.
answers: Nobody told Mai about the party.
exercises.explanation: "Nobody" is already negative, so use a positive verb: told.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Look at the sky! Mai ___ going to be late for her party.
exercises.explanation: Use is going to with Mai.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: We ___ not find the candles, so we used a torch.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: We started the party at three o'clock and it finished at six.
answers: The party lasted from three o'clock to six.
exercises.explanation: Use lasted to say how long something went on.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Everyone ___ "Surprise!" when she opened the door. (shout)

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We are going to have a dance party.
exercises.explanation: Subject + are going to + base verb.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Mai opened the box ___ and found a puppy.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The cake were very big and tasty.
answers: The cake was very big and tasty.
exercises.explanation: Use "was" with one thing: the cake was.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: Mai was very happy because she got a puppy.
answers: Mai got a puppy so she was very happy.
Mai got a puppy, so she was very happy.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: This ___ the best birthday I have ever had!

task.prompt: Write a story called "A Birthday Surprise". Someone has a surprise party.
contentPoints: Say what happened when the person came in.
task.modelAnswer: It was my sister Linh's birthday. We planned a surprise party at home. While she was at school, we put balloons on the walls and made a big cake. When she came in, we shouted, "Happy birthday!" Linh was very surprised and began to laugh. Everyone sang and danced. It was the best day ever.
